name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-retention-records-review
title: Retention and Records Review Dashboard
shortDescription: A read-only SharePoint inventory and review aid for retention and records indicators.
longDescription: Reads configured SharePoint library and folder items, surfaces available retention and record indicators, and highlights missing review metadata. It does not enforce retention policy or change SharePoint data.
